+ # Multimodal Agent Implementation Plan
+ 
+ ## Technical Architecture Overview
+ 
+ Based on the current Juno implementation analysis, here's the specific technical plan for implementing advanced multimodal agent capabilities while preserving the excellent streaming performance.
+ 
+ ## Current Streaming Architecture Analysis
+ 
+ ### Backend Streaming (Rust/Tauri)
+ - **Events**: `agent-stream-start`, `agent-text-stream`, `agent-stream-end`
+ - **Location**: `src-tauri/src/agent/tool_logger.rs`
+ - **Flow**: Anthropic provider → tool_logger → Tauri events → Frontend
+ 
+ ### Frontend Streaming (React/TypeScript)
+ - **Events**: Listened in `src/App.tsx` and `src/contexts/VoiceContext.tsx`
+ - **State**: Message ID tracking, streaming indicators, progressive text display
+ - **Rendering**: JSX detection via `isJsxContent()`, real-time component rendering
+ 
+ ## Phase 1: Enhanced Content Structure (Week 1-2)
+ 
+ ### 1.1 Extend ChatMessage Interface
+ 
+ **File**: `src/App.tsx`
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // Enhanced ChatMessage with multimodal content structure
+ type ChatMessage = {
+   role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "thinking" | "tool_call_request" | "tool_call_result";
+   content: string;
+   
+   // Multimodal content extensions
+   structuredContent?: {
+     visual?: string;      // JSX components
+     markdown?: string;    // Detailed documentation
+     speech?: string;      // TTS-optimized content
+     metadata?: {
+       topic?: string;
+       intent?: 'explanation' | 'task' | 'visual' | 'reference';
+       contentType?: 'text' | 'jsx' | 'markdown' | 'mixed';
+       suggestedPane?: 'main' | 'new' | 'side' | 'below';
+     };
+   };
+   
+   // Pane management
+   paneId?: string;        // Which pane this message belongs to
+   paneCommand?: {         // Agent-generated pane control
+     action: 'create' | 'switch' | 'split' | 'group';
+     target?: string;
+     position?: 'right' | 'below' | 'floating';
+     title?: string;
+   };
+   
+   // Existing fields
+   isJsx?: boolean;
+   screenshot_base64?: string;
+   tool_name?: string;
+   tool_args?: any;
+   tool_output?: any;
+   success?: boolean;
+   timestamp?: number;
+   isStreaming?: boolean;
+   messageId?: string;
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 1.2 Content Parser Enhancement
+ 
+ **File**: `src/lib/structured-content-parser.ts` (new)
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ interface ContentSection {
+   type: 'visual' | 'markdown' | 'text' | 'pane-command';
+   content: string;
+   metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+ }
+ 
+ export class StructuredContentParser {
+   // Parse multimodal content with format markers
+   static parseStructuredContent(content: string): ContentSection[] {
+     const sections: ContentSection[] = [];
+     
+     // Extract JSX visual content
+     const jsxMatches = content.matchAll(/```jsx\s*{\/\*\s*VIS\s*\*\/}(.*?)```/gs);
+     for (const match of jsxMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'visual',
+         content: match[1].trim(),
+         metadata: { rendering: 'jsx' }
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Extract Markdown documentation
+     const mdMatches = content.matchAll(/```markdown\s*<!--\s*MD\s*-->(.*?)```/gs);
+     for (const match of mdMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'markdown',
+         content: match[1].trim(),
+         metadata: { rendering: 'markdown' }
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Extract TTS-optimized text
+     const ttsMatches = content.matchAll(/```text\s*<!--\s*TTS\s*-->(.*?)```/gs);
+     for (const match of ttsMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'text',
+         content: match[1].trim(),
+         metadata: { optimized: 'speech' }
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Extract pane commands
+     const paneMatches = content.matchAll(/\[PANE_COMMAND:\s*(\w+)\((.*?)\)\]/g);
+     for (const match of paneMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'pane-command',
+         content: match[1],
+         metadata: this.parsePaneParameters(match[2])
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // If no structured content found, treat as regular text
+     if (sections.length === 0) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: this.detectContentType(content),
+         content: content.trim()
+       });
+     }
+     
+     return sections;
+   }
+   
+   private static detectContentType(content: string): 'text' | 'visual' {
+     // Use existing JSX detection logic
+     return this.isJsxContent(content) ? 'visual' : 'text';
+   }
+   
+   private static isJsxContent(content: string): boolean {
+     const jsxPattern = /<[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*\s*[^>]*>|<\/[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*>/;
+     return jsxPattern.test(content);
+   }
+   
+   private static parsePaneParameters(paramStr: string): Record<string, any> {
+     // Parse parameters like: title="Demo", type="visual", position="side"
+     const params: Record<string, any> = {};
+     const paramMatches = paramStr.matchAll(/(\w+)="([^"]*?)"/g);
+     for (const match of paramMatches) {
+       params[match[1]] = match[2];
+     }
+     return params;
+   }
+ }
+ ```

+ ```typescript
+ export const StreamingPaneHandler: React.FC = () => {
+   const { panes, createPane, setStreamingPane, clearStreamingPane } = usePaneContext();
+   const [pendingPaneCommands, setPendingPaneCommands] = useState<PaneCommand[]>([]);
+   
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const handleStreamingChunk = (event: any) => {
+       const data = event.payload as StreamingChunk;
+       
+       // Handle pane commands embedded in stream
+       if (data.pane_command) {
+         handlePaneCommand(data.pane_command, data.message_id);
+       }
+       
+       // Route streaming content to appropriate pane
+       const targetPane = determineTargetPane(data);
+       if (targetPane) {
+         setStreamingPane(targetPane, data.message_id);
+       }
+     };
+     
+     const unlisten = listen("agent-text-stream", handleStreamingChunk);
+     
+     return () => {
+       unlisten.then(fn => fn());
+     };
+   }, []);
+   
+   const handlePaneCommand = (command: PaneCommand, messageId: string) => {
+     switch (command.action) {
+       case 'create_pane':
+         const newPaneId = createPane({
+           title: command.parameters.title || 'New Content',
+           type: command.parameters.type || 'topic',
+           position: command.parameters.position || 'right',
+         });
+         
+         // Redirect streaming to new pane
+         setStreamingPane(newPaneId, messageId);
+         break;
+         
+       case 'switch_pane':
+         if (command.parameters.pane_id) {
+           setStreamingPane(command.parameters.pane_id, messageId);
+         }
+         break;
+         
+       case 'split_content':
+         // Create visual pane for JSX content, keep text in main
+         if (command.parameters.content_type === 'visual') {
+           const visualPaneId = createPane({
+             title: command.parameters.title || 'Visual Content',
+             type: 'visual',
+             position: 'side',
+           });
+           setStreamingPane(visualPaneId, messageId);
+         }
+         break;
+     }
+   };
+   
+   const determineTargetPane = (chunk: StreamingChunk): string | null => {
+     // Auto-route based on content type
+     if (chunk.content_type === 'jsx' || chunk.content_type === 'visual') {
+       // Find or create visual pane
+       const visualPane = panes.find(p => p.type === 'visual');
+       if (visualPane) return visualPane.id;
+       
+       // Create new visual pane if none exists
+       return createPane({
+         title: 'Visual Content',
+         type: 'visual',
+         position: 'side',
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Default to active pane for text content
+     return null; // null means use current active pane
+   };
+   
+   return null; // This is a logic-only component
+ };
+ ```

+ ```typescript
+ // Add to existing streaming handlers in App.tsx
+ useEffect(() => {
+   const streamTextListener = listen<StreamingChunk>("agent-text-stream", (event) => {
+     const data = event.payload;
+     const { chunk, message_id, content_type, pane_command } = data;
+     
+     // Handle pane commands first
+     if (pane_command) {
+       // Process pane command without interrupting stream
+       processPaneCommand(pane_command, message_id);
+     }
+     
+     // Route content to appropriate pane
+     const targetPaneId = determineStreamingPane(data);
+     
+     setConversation((prev) => {
+       const updated = [...prev];
+       const messageIndex = updated.findIndex(
+         (msg) => msg.messageId === message_id && msg.isStreaming
+       );
+       
+       if (messageIndex !== -1) {
+         // Update existing streaming message
+         updated[messageIndex] = {
+           ...updated[messageIndex],
+           content: updated[messageIndex].content + chunk,
+           paneId: targetPaneId || updated[messageIndex].paneId,
+         };
+       } else {
+         // Create new streaming message
+         updated.push({
+           role: "assistant",
+           content: chunk,
+           isStreaming: true,
+           messageId: message_id,
+           timestamp: Date.now(),
+           paneId: targetPaneId || 'main',
+           structuredContent: {
+             contentType: content_type || 'text'
+           }
+         });
+       }
+       
+       return updated;
+     });
+   });
+   
+   const streamEndListener = listen<{ message_id: string; complete_text: string }>(
+     "agent-stream-end",
+     (event) => {
+       const { message_id, complete_text } = event.payload;
+       
+       setConversation((prev) => {
+         const updated = [...prev];
+         const messageIndex = updated.findIndex(
+           (msg) => msg.messageId === message_id
+         );
+         
+         if (messageIndex !== -1) {
+           // Parse structured content from complete text
+           const structuredContent = StructuredContentParser.parseStructuredContent(complete_text);
+           
+           updated[messageIndex] = {
+             ...updated[messageIndex],
+             content: complete_text,
+             isStreaming: false,
+             structuredContent: {
+               visual: structuredContent.find(s => s.type === 'visual')?.content,
+               markdown: structuredContent.find(s => s.type === 'markdown')?.content,
+               speech: structuredContent.find(s => s.type === 'text')?.content,
+               contentType: determineOverallContentType(structuredContent)
+             }
+           };
+           
+           // Detect JSX content for compatibility
+           updated[messageIndex].isJsx = isJsxContent(complete_text);
+         }
+         
+         return updated;
+       });
+       
+       setIsProcessing(false);
+     }
+   );
+   
+   return () => {
+     streamTextListener.then((unlistenFn) => unlistenFn());
+     streamEndListener.then((unlistenFn) => unlistenFn());
+   };
+ }, []);
+ 
+ // Wrap main app content with pane providers
+ return (
+   <VoiceProvider>
+     <PaneProvider>
+       <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-background text-foreground">
+         <StreamingPaneHandler />
+         <MultiPaneChatContainer />
+         {/* Existing UI components */}
+       </div>
+     </PaneProvider>
+   </VoiceProvider>
+ );
+ ```

+ ### 4.2 Topic Analysis Integration
+ 
+ **File**: `src/lib/topic-analyzer.ts` (new)
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ export class TopicAnalyzer {
+   private static readonly TOPIC_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.7;
+   
+   static async analyzeMessage(
+     message: string, 
+     context: ChatMessage[]
+   ): Promise<TopicAnalysis> {
+     // Simple keyword-based topic analysis (can be enhanced with ML later)
+     const currentTopics = this.extractTopics(message);
+     const recentTopics = this.extractTopicsFromContext(context.slice(-5));
+     
+     const similarity = this.calculateTopicSimilarity(currentTopics, recentTopics);
+     
+     return {
+       currentTopic: currentTopics[0] || 'general',
+       confidence: similarity,
+       suggestedAction: this.determineSuggestedAction(similarity, currentTopics, recentTopics),
+       relatedTopics: recentTopics,
+     };
+   }
+   
+   private static extractTopics(text: string): string[] {
+     // Enhanced topic extraction with semantic keywords
+     const technicalKeywords = [
+       'code', 'programming', 'function', 'api', 'database', 'algorithm',
+       'react', 'javascript', 'python', 'rust', 'web development'
+     ];
+     
+     const visualKeywords = [
+       'chart', 'graph', 'diagram', 'visualization', 'design', 'ui', 'interface',
+       'circle', 'rectangle', 'shape', 'color', 'layout'
+     ];
+     
+     const taskKeywords = [
+       'create', 'build', 'implement', 'setup', 'configure', 'install',
+       'deploy', 'test', 'debug', 'fix', 'optimize'
+     ];
+     
+     const topics: string[] = [];
+     const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
+     
+     if (technicalKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('technical');
+     }
+     if (visualKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('visual');
+     }
+     if (taskKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('task');
+     }
+     
+     return topics.length > 0 ? topics : ['general'];
+   }
+   
+   private static calculateTopicSimilarity(current: string[], recent: string[]): number {
+     if (current.length === 0 || recent.length === 0) return 0;
+     
+     const intersection = current.filter(topic => recent.includes(topic));
+     return intersection.length / Math.max(current.length, recent.length);
+   }
+   
+   private static determineSuggestedAction(
+     similarity: number, 
+     current: string[], 
+     recent: string[]
+   ): 'continue' | 'new-topic' | 'split' | 'group' {
+     if (similarity > this.TOPIC_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) {
+       return 'continue';
+     }
+     
+     // Suggest splitting if switching from text to visual content
+     if (recent.includes('general') && current.includes('visual')) {
+       return 'split';
+     }
+     
+     // Suggest new topic if completely different domains
+     if (similarity < 0.3) {
+       return 'new-topic';
+     }
+     
+     return 'group';
+   }
+ }
+ ```

```diff
+ interface ContentSection {
+   type: 'visual' | 'markdown' | 'text' | 'pane-command';
+   content: string;
+   metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface StructuredResponse {
+   visual?: string;    // JSX components for visual display
+   markdown?: string;  // Detailed information and documentation
+   text?: string;      // TTS-optimized speech content
+   metadata?: {
+     topic?: string;
+     intent?: 'explanation' | 'task' | 'visual' | 'reference';
+     contentType?: 'text' | 'jsx' | 'markdown' | 'mixed';
+     suggestedPane?: 'main' | 'new' | 'side' | 'below';
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ export interface TopicAnalysis {
+   currentTopic: string;
+   confidence: number;
+   suggestedAction: 'continue' | 'new-topic' | 'split' | 'group';
+   relatedTopics: string[];
+ }
+ 
+ export class StructuredContentParser {
+   // Parse multimodal content with format markers
+   static parseStructuredContent(content: string): ContentSection[] {
+     const sections: ContentSection[] = [];
+     
+     // Extract JSX visual content
+     const jsxMatches = content.matchAll(/```jsx\s*{\/\*\s*VIS\s*\*\/}(.*?)```/gs);
+     for (const match of jsxMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'visual',
+         content: match[1].trim(),
+         metadata: { rendering: 'jsx' }
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Extract Markdown documentation
+     const mdMatches = content.matchAll(/```markdown\s*<!--\s*MD\s*-->(.*?)```/gs);
+     for (const match of mdMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'markdown',
+         content: match[1].trim(),
+         metadata: { rendering: 'markdown' }
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Extract TTS-optimized text
+     const ttsMatches = content.matchAll(/```text\s*<!--\s*TTS\s*-->(.*?)```/gs);
+     for (const match of ttsMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'text',
+         content: match[1].trim(),
+         metadata: { optimized: 'speech' }
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Extract pane commands
+     const paneMatches = content.matchAll(/\[PANE_COMMAND:\s*(\w+)\((.*?)\)\]/g);
+     for (const match of paneMatches) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: 'pane-command',
+         content: match[1],
+         metadata: this.parsePaneParameters(match[2])
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // If no structured content found, treat as regular text
+     if (sections.length === 0) {
+       sections.push({
+         type: this.detectContentType(content),
+         content: content.trim()
+       });
+     }
+     
+     return sections;
+   }
+   
+   // Convert sections back to structured response
+   static sectionsToStructuredResponse(sections: ContentSection[]): StructuredResponse {
+     const response: StructuredResponse = {};
+     
+     for (const section of sections) {
+       switch (section.type) {
+         case 'visual':
+           response.visual = section.content;
+           break;
+         case 'markdown':
+           response.markdown = section.content;
+           break;
+         case 'text':
+           response.text = section.content;
+           break;
+       }
+     }
+     
+     // Infer metadata
+     response.metadata = this.inferContentMetadata(sections);
+     
+     return response;
+   }
+   
+   private static detectContentType(content: string): 'text' | 'visual' {
+     // Use existing JSX detection logic
+     return this.isJsxContent(content) ? 'visual' : 'text';
+   }
+   
+   private static isJsxContent(content: string): boolean {
+     const jsxPattern = /<[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*\s*[^>]*>|<\/[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*>/;
+     return jsxPattern.test(content);
+   }
+   
+   private static parsePaneParameters(paramStr: string): Record<string, any> {
+     // Parse parameters like: title="Demo", type="visual", position="side"
+     const params: Record<string, any> = {};
+     const paramMatches = paramStr.matchAll(/(\w+)="([^"]*?)"/g);
+     for (const match of paramMatches) {
+       params[match[1]] = match[2];
+     }
+     return params;
+   }
+   
+   private static inferContentMetadata(sections: ContentSection[]): StructuredResponse['metadata'] {
+     const hasVisual = sections.some(s => s.type === 'visual');
+     const hasMarkdown = sections.some(s => s.type === 'markdown');
+     const hasText = sections.some(s => s.type === 'text');
+     const hasPaneCommand = sections.some(s => s.type === 'pane-command');
+     
+     let contentType: 'text' | 'jsx' | 'markdown' | 'mixed' = 'text';
+     if (hasVisual && hasMarkdown) contentType = 'mixed';
+     else if (hasVisual) contentType = 'jsx';
+     else if (hasMarkdown) contentType = 'markdown';
+     
+     let intent: 'explanation' | 'task' | 'visual' | 'reference' = 'explanation';
+     if (hasVisual) intent = 'visual';
+     else if (hasMarkdown) intent = 'reference';
+     
+     let suggestedPane: 'main' | 'new' | 'side' | 'below' = 'main';
+     if (hasPaneCommand || hasVisual) suggestedPane = 'side';
+     else if (hasMarkdown) suggestedPane = 'below';
+     
+     return {
+       contentType,
+       intent,
+       suggestedPane,
+     };
+   }
+ }
```

```diff
+ import { TopicAnalysis } from './structured-content-parser';
+ 
+ export interface ChatMessage {
+   role: string;
+   content: string;
+   timestamp?: number;
+   isJsx?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export class TopicAnalyzer {
+   private static readonly TOPIC_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.7;
+   
+   static async analyzeMessage(
+     message: string, 
+     context: ChatMessage[]
+   ): Promise<TopicAnalysis> {
+     // Simple keyword-based topic analysis (can be enhanced with ML later)
+     const currentTopics = this.extractTopics(message);
+     const recentTopics = this.extractTopicsFromContext(context.slice(-5));
+     
+     const similarity = this.calculateTopicSimilarity(currentTopics, recentTopics);
+     
+     return {
+       currentTopic: currentTopics[0] || 'general',
+       confidence: similarity,
+       suggestedAction: this.determineSuggestedAction(similarity, currentTopics, recentTopics),
+       relatedTopics: recentTopics,
+     };
+   }
+   
+   static extractTopics(text: string): string[] {
+     // Enhanced topic extraction with semantic keywords
+     const technicalKeywords = [
+       'code', 'programming', 'function', 'api', 'database', 'algorithm',
+       'react', 'javascript', 'python', 'rust', 'web development', 'typescript',
+       'component', 'interface', 'class', 'method', 'variable', 'import'
+     ];
+     
+     const visualKeywords = [
+       'chart', 'graph', 'diagram', 'visualization', 'design', 'ui', 'interface',
+       'circle', 'rectangle', 'shape', 'color', 'layout', 'card', 'button',
+       'visual', 'display', 'render', 'component', 'jsx', 'style'
+     ];
+     
+     const taskKeywords = [
+       'create', 'build', 'implement', 'setup', 'configure', 'install',
+       'deploy', 'test', 'debug', 'fix', 'optimize', 'run', 'execute',
+       'make', 'generate', 'develop', 'write', 'add', 'update'
+     ];
+     
+     const documentationKeywords = [
+       'documentation', 'docs', 'readme', 'guide', 'tutorial', 'example',
+       'reference', 'manual', 'help', 'instruction', 'explain', 'description',
+       'overview', 'summary', 'details'
+     ];
+     
+     const topics: string[] = [];
+     const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
+     
+     if (technicalKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('technical');
+     }
+     if (visualKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('visual');
+     }
+     if (taskKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('task');
+     }
+     if (documentationKeywords.some(keyword => lowerText.includes(keyword))) {
+       topics.push('documentation');
+     }
+     
+     return topics.length > 0 ? topics : ['general'];
+   }
+   
+   private static extractTopicsFromContext(messages: ChatMessage[]): string[] {
+     const allTopics: string[] = [];
+     
+     for (const message of messages) {
+       const messageTopics = this.extractTopics(message.content);
+       allTopics.push(...messageTopics);
+     }
+     
+     // Return unique topics
+     return [...new Set(allTopics)];
+   }
+   
+   private static calculateTopicSimilarity(current: string[], recent: string[]): number {
+     if (current.length === 0 || recent.length === 0) return 0;
+     
+     const intersection = current.filter(topic => recent.includes(topic));
+     return intersection.length / Math.max(current.length, recent.length);
+   }
+   
+   private static determineSuggestedAction(
+     similarity: number, 
+     current: string[], 
+     recent: string[]
+   ): 'continue' | 'new-topic' | 'split' | 'group' {
+     if (similarity > this.TOPIC_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) {
+       return 'continue';
+     }
+     
+     // Suggest splitting if switching from text to visual content
+     if (recent.includes('general') && current.includes('visual')) {
+       return 'split';
+     }
+     
+     // Suggest splitting if introducing documentation alongside technical content
+     if (current.includes('documentation') && recent.includes('technical')) {
+       return 'split';
+     }
+     
+     // Suggest new topic if completely different domains
+     if (similarity < 0.3) {
+       return 'new-topic';
+     }
+     
+     return 'group';
+   }
+   
+   // Suggest optimal pane type based on content analysis
+   static suggestPaneType(topics: string[]): 'visual' | 'reference' | 'task' | 'topic' {
+     if (topics.includes('visual')) return 'visual';
+     if (topics.includes('documentation')) return 'reference';
+     if (topics.includes('task')) return 'task';
+     return 'topic';
+   }
+   
+   // Suggest pane position based on content type and current layout
+   static suggestPanePosition(contentType: string, hasExistingPanes: boolean): 'side' | 'below' | 'floating' {
+     if (contentType === 'visual' || contentType === 'jsx') {
+       return hasExistingPanes ? 'floating' : 'side';
+     }
+     if (contentType === 'documentation' || contentType === 'markdown') {
+       return 'below';
+     }
+     return 'side';
+   }
+ }
```

```diff
+ import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { StructuredContentParser } from '@/lib/structured-content-parser';
+ import { TopicAnalyzer } from '@/lib/topic-analyzer';
+ 
+ // Enhanced ChatMessage interface for multimodal content
+ export interface ChatMessage {
+   role: "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "thinking" | "tool_call_request" | "tool_call_result";
+   content: string;
+   
+   // Multimodal content extensions
+   structuredContent?: {
+     visual?: string;      // JSX components
+     markdown?: string;    // Detailed documentation
+     speech?: string;      // TTS-optimized content
+     metadata?: {
+       topic?: string;
+       intent?: 'explanation' | 'task' | 'visual' | 'reference';
+       contentType?: 'text' | 'jsx' | 'markdown' | 'mixed';
+       suggestedPane?: 'main' | 'new' | 'side' | 'below';
+     };
+   };
+   
+   // Pane management
+   paneId?: string;        // Which pane this message belongs to
+   paneCommand?: {         // Agent-generated pane control
+     action: 'create' | 'switch' | 'split' | 'group';
+     target?: string;
+     position?: 'right' | 'below' | 'floating';
+     title?: string;
+   };
+   
+   // Existing fields
+   isJsx?: boolean;
+   screenshot_base64?: string;
+   tool_name?: string;
+   tool_args?: any;
+   tool_output?: any;
+   success?: boolean;
+   timestamp?: number;
+   isStreaming?: boolean;
+   messageId?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface ChatPane {
+   id: string;
+   type: 'main' | 'topic' | 'visual' | 'reference' | 'task';
+   title: string;
+   messages: ChatMessage[];
+   position: {
+     x: number;
+     y: number;
+     width: number;
+     height: number;
+   };
+   parentId?: string;
+   createdAt: number;
+   isActive: boolean;
+   streamingMessageId?: string; // Track which message is currently streaming to this pane
+ }
+ 
+ export interface CreatePaneOptions {
+   title?: string;
+   type?: ChatPane['type'];
+   position?: 'right' | 'below' | 'floating';
+   initialMessages?: ChatMessage[];
+   parentId?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface PaneContextValue {
+   panes: ChatPane[];
+   activePane: string;
+   layout: 'single' | 'split-horizontal' | 'split-vertical' | 'grid';
+   
+   // Actions
+   createPane: (options: CreatePaneOptions) => string;
+   switchToPane: (paneId: string) => void;
+   splitPane: (paneId: string, direction: 'horizontal' | 'vertical') => string;
+   closePane: (paneId: string) => void;
+   moveMessage: (messageId: string, fromPane: string, toPane: string) => void;
+   addMessageToPane: (paneId: string, message: ChatMessage) => void;
+   updateMessage: (paneId: string, messageId: string, updates: Partial<ChatMessage>) => void;
+   
+   // Streaming support
+   setStreamingPane: (paneId: string, messageId: string) => void;
+   clearStreamingPane: (paneId: string) => void;
+   getStreamingPane: () => string | null;
+   
+   // Content organization
+   distributeMessage: (message: ChatMessage) => string; // Returns pane ID where message was placed
+   reorganizeByTopic: () => void;
+ }
+ 
+ const PaneContext = createContext<PaneContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
+ 
+ export const usePaneContext = () => {
+   const context = useContext(PaneContext);
+   if (!context) {
+     throw new Error('usePaneContext must be used within a PaneProvider');
+   }
+   return context;
+ };
+ 
+ export const PaneProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
+   const [panes, setPanes] = useState<ChatPane[]>([
+     {
+       id: 'main',
+       type: 'main',
+       title: 'Main Chat',
+       messages: [],
+       position: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100 },
+       createdAt: Date.now(),
+       isActive: true,
+     }
+   ]);
+   
+   const [activePane, setActivePane] = useState('main');
+   const [layout, setLayout] = useState<'single' | 'split-horizontal' | 'split-vertical' | 'grid'>('single');
+   
+   // Calculate pane position based on current layout and new pane preferences
+   const calculatePanePosition = useCallback((
+     preferredPosition: CreatePaneOptions['position'], 
+     existingPanes: ChatPane[]
+   ) => {
+     const paneCount = existingPanes.length;
+     
+     switch (preferredPosition) {
+       case 'right':
+         return { x: 50, y: 0, width: 50, height: 100 };
+       case 'below':
+         return { x: 0, y: 50, width: 100, height: 50 };
+       case 'floating':
+         return { 
+           x: 10 + (paneCount * 5), 
+           y: 10 + (paneCount * 5), 
+           width: 40, 
+           height: 40 
+         };
+       default:
+         // Auto-calculate based on existing layout
+         if (paneCount === 1) {
+           return { x: 50, y: 0, width: 50, height: 100 };
+         } else {
+           const gridSize = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(paneCount + 1));
+           const cellWidth = 100 / gridSize;
+           const cellHeight = 100 / gridSize;
+           const row = Math.floor(paneCount / gridSize);
+           const col = paneCount % gridSize;
+           return {
+             x: col * cellWidth,
+             y: row * cellHeight,
+             width: cellWidth,
+             height: cellHeight
+           };
+         }
+     }
+   }, []);
+   
+   const createPane = useCallback((options: CreatePaneOptions): string => {
+     const newPane: ChatPane = {
+       id: `pane-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,
+       type: options.type || 'topic',
+       title: options.title || 'New Pane',
+       messages: options.initialMessages || [],
+       position: calculatePanePosition(options.position, panes),
+       parentId: options.parentId,
+       createdAt: Date.now(),
+       isActive: false,
+     };
+     
+     setPanes(prev => [...prev, newPane]);
+     
+     // Update layout if needed
+     if (layout === 'single' && panes.length === 1) {
+       setLayout(options.position === 'below' ? 'split-horizontal' : 'split-vertical');
+     } else if (panes.length >= 3) {
+       setLayout('grid');
+     }
+     
+     return newPane.id;
+   }, [panes, layout, calculatePanePosition]);
+   
+   const switchToPane = useCallback((paneId: string) => {
+     setActivePane(paneId);
+     setPanes(prev => prev.map(pane => ({
+       ...pane,
+       isActive: pane.id === paneId
+     })));
+   }, []);
+   
+   const splitPane = useCallback((paneId: string, direction: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'): string => {
+     const sourcePane = panes.find(p => p.id === paneId);
+     if (!sourcePane) return '';
+     
+     const newPaneId = createPane({
+       title: `${sourcePane.title} - Split`,
+       type: sourcePane.type,
+       position: direction === 'horizontal' ? 'below' : 'right',
+       parentId: paneId,
+     });
+     
+     setLayout(direction === 'horizontal' ? 'split-horizontal' : 'split-vertical');
+     
+     return newPaneId;
+   }, [panes, createPane]);
+   
+   const closePane = useCallback((paneId: string) => {
+     if (paneId === 'main') return; // Cannot close main pane
+     
+     setPanes(prev => {
+       const remaining = prev.filter(p => p.id !== paneId);
+       
+       // If closed pane was active, switch to main
+       if (activePane === paneId) {
+         setActivePane('main');
+       }
+       
+       // Update layout based on remaining panes
+       if (remaining.length === 1) {
+         setLayout('single');
+       } else if (remaining.length === 2) {
+         setLayout('split-vertical');
+       }
+       
+       return remaining;
+     });
+   }, [activePane]);
+   
+   const moveMessage = useCallback((messageId: string, fromPane: string, toPane: string) => {
+     setPanes(prev => {
+       const updated = [...prev];
+       
+       // Find and remove message from source pane
+       const sourceIndex = updated.findIndex(p => p.id === fromPane);
+       const targetIndex = updated.findIndex(p => p.id === toPane);
+       
+       if (sourceIndex === -1 || targetIndex === -1) return prev;
+       
+       const messageIndex = updated[sourceIndex].messages.findIndex(m => m.messageId === messageId);
+       if (messageIndex === -1) return prev;
+       
+       const message = updated[sourceIndex].messages[messageIndex];
+       
+       // Remove from source
+       updated[sourceIndex] = {
+         ...updated[sourceIndex],
+         messages: updated[sourceIndex].messages.filter(m => m.messageId !== messageId)
+       };
+       
+       // Add to target with updated paneId
+       updated[targetIndex] = {
+         ...updated[targetIndex],
+         messages: [...updated[targetIndex].messages, { ...message, paneId: toPane }]
+       };
+       
+       return updated;
+     });
+   }, []);
+   
+   const addMessageToPane = useCallback((paneId: string, message: ChatMessage) => {
+     setPanes(prev => prev.map(pane => 
+       pane.id === paneId 
+         ? { ...pane, messages: [...pane.messages, { ...message, paneId }] }
+         : pane
+     ));
+   }, []);
+   
+   const updateMessage = useCallback((paneId: string, messageId: string, updates: Partial<ChatMessage>) => {
+     setPanes(prev => prev.map(pane => 
+       pane.id === paneId 
+         ? {
+             ...pane,
+             messages: pane.messages.map(msg => 
+               msg.messageId === messageId ? { ...msg, ...updates } : msg
+             )
+           }
+         : pane
+     ));
+   }, []);
+   
+   const setStreamingPane = useCallback((paneId: string, messageId: string) => {
+     setPanes(prev => prev.map(pane => ({
+       ...pane,
+       streamingMessageId: pane.id === paneId ? messageId : undefined
+     })));
+   }, []);
+   
+   const clearStreamingPane = useCallback((paneId: string) => {
+     setPanes(prev => prev.map(pane => 
+       pane.id === paneId 
+         ? { ...pane, streamingMessageId: undefined }
+         : pane
+     ));
+   }, []);
+   
+   const getStreamingPane = useCallback((): string | null => {
+     const streamingPane = panes.find(p => p.streamingMessageId);
+     return streamingPane?.id || null;
+   }, [panes]);
+   
+   const distributeMessage = useCallback((message: ChatMessage): string => {
+     // If message has explicit pane assignment, use it
+     if (message.paneId && panes.find(p => p.id === message.paneId)) {
+       addMessageToPane(message.paneId, message);
+       return message.paneId;
+     }
+     
+     // Analyze content to determine best pane
+     const sections = StructuredContentParser.parseStructuredContent(message.content);
+     const structuredContent = StructuredContentParser.sectionsToStructuredResponse(sections);
+     
+     // Handle pane commands
+     const paneCommands = sections.filter(s => s.type === 'pane-command');
+     if (paneCommands.length > 0) {
+       const command = paneCommands[0];
+       if (command.content === 'create_pane') {
+         const newPaneId = createPane({
+           title: command.metadata?.title || 'New Content',
+           type: command.metadata?.type || 'topic',
+           position: command.metadata?.position || 'side',
+         });
+         addMessageToPane(newPaneId, { ...message, paneId: newPaneId, structuredContent });
+         switchToPane(newPaneId);
+         return newPaneId;
+       }
+     }
+     
+     // Auto-route based on content type
+     if (structuredContent.visual) {
+       // Visual content goes to visual pane or creates one
+       let visualPane = panes.find(p => p.type === 'visual');
+       if (!visualPane) {
+         const newPaneId = createPane({
+           title: 'Visual Content',
+           type: 'visual',
+           position: 'side',
+         });
+         visualPane = panes.find(p => p.id === newPaneId);
+       }
+       if (visualPane) {
+         addMessageToPane(visualPane.id, { ...message, paneId: visualPane.id, structuredContent });
+         return visualPane.id;
+       }
+     }
+     
+     if (structuredContent.markdown) {
+       // Documentation goes to reference pane or creates one
+       let refPane = panes.find(p => p.type === 'reference');
+       if (!refPane) {
+         const newPaneId = createPane({
+           title: 'Documentation',
+           type: 'reference',
+           position: 'below',
+         });
+         refPane = panes.find(p => p.id === newPaneId);
+       }
+       if (refPane) {
+         addMessageToPane(refPane.id, { ...message, paneId: refPane.id, structuredContent });
+         return refPane.id;
+       }
+     }
+     
+     // Default to main pane
+     addMessageToPane('main', { ...message, paneId: 'main', structuredContent });
+     return 'main';
+   }, [panes, addMessageToPane, createPane, switchToPane]);
+   
+   const reorganizeByTopic = useCallback(async () => {
+     // Analyze all messages and group by topic
+     const allMessages = panes.flatMap(p => p.messages);
+     const topicGroups: Record<string, ChatMessage[]> = {};
+     
+     for (const message of allMessages) {
+       const topics = TopicAnalyzer.extractTopics(message.content);
+       const primaryTopic = topics[0] || 'general';
+       
+       if (!topicGroups[primaryTopic]) {
+         topicGroups[primaryTopic] = [];
+       }
+       topicGroups[primaryTopic].push(message);
+     }
+     
+     // Create panes for each topic group (except general)
+     const newPanes: ChatPane[] = [{
+       id: 'main',
+       type: 'main',
+       title: 'Main Chat',
+       messages: topicGroups['general'] || [],
+       position: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100 },
+       createdAt: Date.now(),
+       isActive: true,
+     }];
+     
+     Object.entries(topicGroups).forEach(([topic, messages], index) => {
+       if (topic !== 'general' && messages.length > 0) {
+         const paneType = TopicAnalyzer.suggestPaneType([topic]);
+         newPanes.push({
+           id: `topic-${topic}-${Date.now()}`,
+           type: paneType,
+           title: `${topic.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + topic.slice(1)} Content`,
+           messages: messages.map(m => ({ ...m, paneId: `topic-${topic}-${Date.now()}` })),
+           position: {
+             x: (index % 2) * 50,
+             y: Math.floor(index / 2) * 50,
+             width: 50,
+             height: 50
+           },
+           createdAt: Date.now(),
+           isActive: false,
+         });
+       }
+     });
+     
+     setPanes(newPanes);
+     setLayout(newPanes.length > 2 ? 'grid' : newPanes.length === 2 ? 'split-vertical' : 'single');
+   }, [panes]);
+   
+   const contextValue: PaneContextValue = {
+     panes,
+     activePane,
+     layout,
+     createPane,
+     switchToPane,
+     splitPane,
+     closePane,
+     moveMessage,
+     addMessageToPane,
+     updateMessage,
+     setStreamingPane,
+     clearStreamingPane,
+     getStreamingPane,
+     distributeMessage,
+     reorganizeByTopic,
+   };
+   
+   return (
+     <PaneContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
+       {children}
+     </PaneContext.Provider>
+   );
+ };
```

```diff
+ import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import { listen } from '@tauri-apps/api/event';
+ import { usePaneContext } from '@/contexts/PaneContext';
+ 
+ // Enhanced streaming interfaces
+ export interface StreamingChunk {
+   chunk: string;
+   message_id: string;
+   content_type?: string; // "text", "jsx", "markdown", "pane-command"
+   pane_command?: PaneCommand;
+   section_complete?: boolean; // True when a structured section is complete
+ }
+ 
+ export interface PaneCommand {
+   action: string; // "create_pane", "switch_pane", "split_content"
+   parameters: Record<string, any>;
+ }
+ 
+ export function StreamingPaneHandler() {
+   const { panes, createPane, setStreamingPane, clearStreamingPane } = usePaneContext();
+   const [pendingPaneCommands, setPendingPaneCommands] = useState<PaneCommand[]>([]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const handleStreamingChunk = (event: any) => {
+       const data = event.payload as StreamingChunk;
+       
+       // Handle pane commands embedded in stream
+       if (data.pane_command) {
+         handlePaneCommand(data.pane_command, data.message_id);
+       }
+       
+       // Route streaming content to appropriate pane
+       const targetPane = determineTargetPane(data);
+       if (targetPane) {
+         setStreamingPane(targetPane, data.message_id);
+       }
+     };
+     
+     const unlisten = listen("agent-text-stream", handleStreamingChunk);
+     
+     return () => {
+       unlisten.then(fn => fn());
+     };
+   }, [panes, createPane, setStreamingPane]);
+ 
+   const handlePaneCommand = (command: PaneCommand, messageId: string) => {
+     switch (command.action) {
+       case 'create_pane':
+         const newPaneId = createPane({
+           title: command.parameters.title || 'New Content',
+           type: command.parameters.type || 'topic',
+           position: command.parameters.position || 'right',
+         });
+         
+         // Redirect streaming to new pane
+         setStreamingPane(newPaneId, messageId);
+         break;
+         
+       case 'switch_pane':
+         if (command.parameters.pane_id) {
+           setStreamingPane(command.parameters.pane_id, messageId);
+         }
+         break;
+         
+       case 'split_content':
+         // Create visual pane for JSX content, keep text in main
+         if (command.parameters.content_type === 'visual') {
+           const visualPaneId = createPane({
+             title: command.parameters.title || 'Visual Content',
+             type: 'visual',
+             position: 'side',
+           });
+           setStreamingPane(visualPaneId, messageId);
+         }
+         break;
+         
+       default:
+         // Store unknown commands for later processing
+         setPendingPaneCommands(prev => [...prev, command]);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const determineTargetPane = (chunk: StreamingChunk): string | null => {
+     // Auto-route based on content type
+     if (chunk.content_type === 'jsx' || chunk.content_type === 'visual') {
+       // Find or create visual pane
+       const visualPane = panes.find(p => p.type === 'visual');
+       if (visualPane) return visualPane.id;
+       
+       // Create new visual pane if none exists
+       return createPane({
+         title: 'Visual Content',
+         type: 'visual',
+         position: 'side',
+       });
+     }
+     
+     if (chunk.content_type === 'markdown') {
+       // Documentation goes to reference pane
+       const refPane = panes.find(p => p.type === 'reference');
+       if (refPane) return refPane.id;
+       
+       // Create new reference pane if none exists
+       return createPane({
+         title: 'Documentation',
+         type: 'reference',
+         position: 'below',
+       });
+     }
+     
+     // Default to active pane for text content
+     return null; // null means use current active pane
+   };
+ 
+   // Clean up pending commands periodically
+   useEffect(() => {
+     if (pendingPaneCommands.length > 0) {
+       const timer = setTimeout(() => {
+         setPendingPaneCommands([]);
+       }, 5000); // Clear after 5 seconds
+       
+       return () => clearTimeout(timer);
+     }
+   }, [pendingPaneCommands]);
+ 
+   // This is a logic-only component
+   return null;
+ }
```

```diff
+ import { useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { usePaneContext, ChatMessage } from '@/contexts/PaneContext';
+ import { ChatPaneContainer } from './ChatPaneContainer';
+ import {
+   ResizableHandle,
+   ResizablePanel,
+   ResizablePanelGroup,
+ } from '@/components/ui/resizable';
+ 
+ interface MultiPaneChatContainerProps {
+   conversation: ChatMessage[];
+   setConversation: (messages: ChatMessage[]) => void;
+ }
+ 
+ export function MultiPaneChatContainer({ 
+   conversation, 
+   setConversation 
+ }: MultiPaneChatContainerProps) {
+   const { panes, layout, activePane, switchToPane, distributeMessage } = usePaneContext();
+ 
+   // Distribute new messages to appropriate panes
+   useEffect(() => {
+     // Find messages that don't have pane assignments yet
+     const unassignedMessages = conversation.filter(msg => !msg.paneId);
+     
+     unassignedMessages.forEach(message => {
+       const assignedPaneId = distributeMessage(message);
+       
+       // Update the conversation with pane assignment
+       setConversation(conversation.map(msg => 
+         msg.messageId === message.messageId 
+           ? { ...msg, paneId: assignedPaneId }
+           : msg
+       ));
+     });
+   }, [conversation, distributeMessage, setConversation]);
+ 
+   const renderPaneLayout = () => {
+     switch (layout) {
+       case 'single':
+         const mainPane = panes.find(p => p.id === activePane) || panes[0];
+         return <SinglePaneView pane={mainPane} conversation={conversation} />;
+       
+       case 'split-horizontal':
+         return (
+           <ResizablePanelGroup direction="horizontal" className="h-full">
+             {panes.map((pane, index) => (
+               <ResizablePanel 
+                 key={pane.id} 
+                 defaultSize={100 / panes.length}
+                 minSize={20}
+               >
+                 <ChatPaneContainer 
+                   pane={pane} 
+                   isActive={pane.id === activePane}
+                   onActivate={() => switchToPane(pane.id)}
+                   conversation={conversation}
+                 />
+                 {index < panes.length - 1 && <ResizableHandle />}
+               </ResizablePanel>
+             ))}
+           </ResizablePanelGroup>
+         );
+       
+       case 'split-vertical':
+         return (
+           <ResizablePanelGroup direction="vertical" className="h-full">
+             {panes.map((pane, index) => (
+               <ResizablePanel 
+                 key={pane.id} 
+                 defaultSize={100 / panes.length}
+                 minSize={20}
+               >
+                 <ChatPaneContainer 
+                   pane={pane} 
+                   isActive={pane.id === activePane}
+                   onActivate={() => switchToPane(pane.id)}
+                   conversation={conversation}
+                 />
+                 {index < panes.length - 1 && <ResizableHandle />}
+               </ResizablePanel>
+             ))}
+           </ResizablePanelGroup>
+         );
+       
+       case 'grid':
+         return (
+           <div className="h-full grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-2">
+             {panes.map((pane) => (
+               <div 
+                 key={pane.id}
+                 className={`min-h-0 border rounded-lg ${
+                   pane.id === activePane 
+                     ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500 border-blue-300' 
+                     : 'border-border'
+                 }`}
+               >
+                 <ChatPaneContainer 
+                   pane={pane} 
+                   isActive={pane.id === activePane}
+                   onActivate={() => switchToPane(pane.id)}
+                   conversation={conversation}
+                 />
+               </div>
+             ))}
+           </div>
+         );
+       
+       default:
+         const defaultPane = panes.find(p => p.id === activePane) || panes[0];
+         return <SinglePaneView pane={defaultPane} conversation={conversation} />;
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className="multi-pane-container h-full">
+       {renderPaneLayout()}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ interface SinglePaneViewProps {
+   pane: any;
+   conversation: ChatMessage[];
+ }
+ 
+ function SinglePaneView({ pane, conversation }: SinglePaneViewProps) {
+   const { switchToPane } = usePaneContext();
+   
+   if (!pane) return null;
+   
+   return (
+     <ChatPaneContainer 
+       pane={pane} 
+       isActive={true}
+       onActivate={() => switchToPane(pane.id)}
+       conversation={conversation}
+     />
+   );
+ }
```

```diff
+ import { useMemo } from 'react';
+ import { ChatPane, ChatMessage } from '@/contexts/PaneContext';
+ import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
+ import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
+ import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
+ import { 
+   JsxMessageRenderer, 
+   isJsxContent 
+ } from '@/components/ui/jsx-message-renderer';
+ import {
+   AIMessage,
+   AIMessageContent,
+   AIMessageAvatar,
+   AIResponse,
+ } from '@/components/ui/kibo-ui/ai';
+ import { X, Maximize2, MoreVertical, Split } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+ 
+ interface ChatPaneContainerProps {
+   pane: ChatPane;
+   isActive: boolean;
+   onActivate: () => void;
+   conversation: ChatMessage[];
+ }
+ 
+ export function ChatPaneContainer({
+   pane,
+   isActive,
+   onActivate,
+   conversation,
+ }: ChatPaneContainerProps) {
+   // Filter messages for this pane
+   const paneMessages = useMemo(() => {
+     return conversation.filter(msg => msg.paneId === pane.id);
+   }, [conversation, pane.id]);
+ 
+   const getPaneTypeColor = (type: ChatPane['type']) => {
+     switch (type) {
+       case 'main': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200';
+       case 'visual': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200';
+       case 'reference': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200';
+       case 'task': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-900 dark:text-orange-200';
+       case 'topic': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200';
+       default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const renderMessage = (msg: ChatMessage, index: number) => {
+     const from = msg.role === "user" ? "user" : "assistant";
+     const avatarSrc = msg.role === "user" ? "/user-avatar.png" : "/ai-avatar.png";
+     const avatarName = msg.role === "user" ? "User" : "AI";
+ 
+     return (
+       <AIMessage key={`${pane.id}-msg-${index}-${msg.timestamp || Date.now()}`} from={from}>
+         <AIMessageContent>
+           {msg.role === "assistant" &&
+           (!msg.content || msg.content.trim() === "") ? (
+             <span className="text-muted-foreground italic flex items-center gap-2">
+               <span>✓</span>
+               <span>Task completed successfully</span>
+             </span>
+           ) : msg.structuredContent?.visual ? (
+             // Render structured visual content
+             <div className="space-y-4">
+               <JsxMessageRenderer jsx={msg.structuredContent.visual} />
+               {msg.structuredContent.markdown && (
+                 <div className="border-t pt-4">
+                   <div className="prose dark:prose-invert max-w-none">
+                     {msg.structuredContent.markdown}
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+               )}
+             </div>
+           ) : msg.structuredContent?.markdown ? (
+             // Render structured markdown content
+             <div className="prose dark:prose-invert max-w-none">
+               {msg.structuredContent.markdown}
+             </div>
+           ) : msg.isJsx || (msg.role === "assistant" && !msg.isStreaming && isJsxContent(msg.content)) ? (
+             <JsxMessageRenderer jsx={msg.content} />
+           ) : msg.role === "assistant" && msg.content ? (
+             <AIResponse>{msg.content}</AIResponse>
+           ) : (
+             msg.content
+           )}
+ 
+           {msg.screenshot_base64 && (
+             <div className="mt-2 border-t pt-2">
+               <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">
+                 Screenshot:
+               </div>
+               <div className="relative">
+                 <img
+                   src={`data:image/png;base64,${msg.screenshot_base64}`}
+                   alt="Screenshot"
+                   className="rounded w-full object-contain max-h-[200px] border border-border shadow-sm"
+                 />
+               </div>
+             </div>
+           )}
+ 
+           {msg.isStreaming && (
+             <span className="inline-block w-2 h-4 bg-current ml-1 animate-pulse">
+               |
+             </span>
+           )}
+         </AIMessageContent>
+         <AIMessageAvatar src={avatarSrc} name={avatarName} />
+       </AIMessage>
+     );
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <div 
+       className={cn(
+         "flex flex-col h-full border rounded-lg bg-background",
+         isActive ? "ring-2 ring-blue-500 border-blue-300" : "border-border"
+       )}
+       onClick={onActivate}
+     >
+       {/* Pane Header */}
+       <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b bg-muted/50">
+         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

+             {pane.title}

+             <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
+               ({paneMessages.length})

+           {pane.streamingMessageId && (
+             <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full animate-pulse" />

+         </div>
+         
+         <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
+           {pane.id !== 'main' && (

+               <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-6 w-6 p-0">

+               <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-6 w-6 p-0">
```

      }

+ // Enhanced streaming emission with structured content support
+ pub fn emit_structured_streaming_chunk(
+     app_handle: &AppHandle, 
+     chunk: String, 
+     message_id: String,
+     content_type: Option<String>,
+     pane_command: Option<PaneCommand>
+ ) {
+     let streaming_data = EnhancedStreamingTextPayload {
+         chunk,
+         message_id,
+         content_type,
+         pane_command,
+         section_complete: false,
+     };
+     
+     if let Err(e) = app_handle.emit(crate::constants::events::AGENT_TEXT_STREAM, streaming_data) {
+         warn!("Failed to emit structured streaming chunk: {}", e);
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ // Parse content for format markers and emit appropriate chunks
+ pub fn emit_multimodal_streaming_chunk(
+     app_handle: &AppHandle,
+     text: String,
+     message_id: String,
+ ) {
+     // Check for pane commands
+     if let Some(pane_command) = parse_pane_command(&text) {
+         emit_structured_streaming_chunk(
+             app_handle,
+             text.clone(),
+             message_id.clone(),
+             Some("pane-command".to_string()),
+             Some(pane_command),
+         );
+         return;
+     }
+     
+     // Check for JSX content markers
+     if text.contains("```jsx") && text.contains("{/* VIS */}") {
+         emit_structured_streaming_chunk(
+             app_handle,
+             text,
+             message_id,
+             Some("jsx".to_string()),
+             None,
+         );
+         return;
+     }
+     
+     // Check for Markdown content markers
+     if text.contains("```markdown") && text.contains("<!-- MD -->") {
+         emit_structured_streaming_chunk(
+             app_handle,
+             text,
+             message_id,
+             Some("markdown".to_string()),
+             None,
+         );
+         return;
+     }
+     
+     // Check for TTS content markers
+     if text.contains("```text") && text.contains("<!-- TTS -->") {
+         emit_structured_streaming_chunk(
+             app_handle,
+             text,
+             message_id,
+             Some("text".to_string()),
+             None,
+         );
+         return;
+     }
+     
+     // Default to regular text streaming
+     emit_streaming_text_chunk(app_handle, text, Some(message_id));
+ }
+ 
+ // Parse pane commands from text
+ fn parse_pane_command(text: &str) -> Option<PaneCommand> {
+     // Look for pattern: [PANE_COMMAND: action(param1="value1", param2="value2")]
+     if let Some(captures) = regex::Regex::new(r"\[PANE_COMMAND:\s*(\w+)\((.*?)\)\]")
+         .ok()?
+         .captures(text) 
+     {
+         let action = captures.get(1)?.as_str().to_string();
+         let params_str = captures.get(2)?.as_str();
+         
+         // Parse parameters
+         let mut parameters = serde_json::Map::new();
+         for param_match in regex::Regex::new(r#"(\w+)="([^"]*?)""#)
+             .ok()?
+             .captures_iter(params_str) 
+         {
+             if let (Some(key), Some(value)) = (param_match.get(1), param_match.get(2)) {
+                 parameters.insert(
+                     key.as_str().to_string(), 
+                     serde_json::Value::String(value.as_str().to_string())
+                 );
+             }
+         }
+         
+         Some(PaneCommand {
+             action,
+             parameters: serde_json::Value::Object(parameters),
+         })
+     } else {
+         None
+     }
+ }
+
